description: Authoritative registry of headless conformance suites across all RFC domains. This is the single owner of which suites exist, what they cover, how they build, and their expected outcome. Domains add ONE row here when they land a new conformance suite; the shared runner (tools/quality/conformance.py) builds, runs, and evidences every row uniformly so a suite can never silently drift out of the gate. Profiles own toolchain/flag facts (quality/profiles/); this manifest references them by id.

suites.description: RFC 0011 G4: the radiosity producer's patch gather, probe gather and composition on the job system's batch executor with 1, 2 and N real worker threads produce the serial oracle's bytes exactly over a 40000-patch synthetic stress transfer

jobsystem.radiosity under ThreadSanitizer (the stress configuration). Needs a compiler with a TSan runtime: CONFORMANCE_TSAN=1 python3 tools/quality/conformance.py check --cxx clang++ --suite jobsystem.radiosity.tsan
The TSan lane's negative control: jobsystem.radiosity with a seeded unsynchronized counter written by concurrent batch items (-DRADIOSITY_SEED_RACE) must fail under ThreadSanitizer

RFC 0011 producer contract: the shared suite passes the Baked producer, the precomputed radiosity producer (BakedPlusDelta over the furnace transfer) and a scripted fake, and rejects each of the seven deliberately bad producers and a one-bounce radiosity producer; render.indirect-switching's scenarios (baked <-> fake, a failed Begin, device loss mid-fade, backgrounding, map change) against a fake GPU timeline

RFC 0011 baked direct light blocked by moving geometry (render/direct_occlusion.h) on a synthetic floor: no occluder leaves the bake's bytes; a box between the floor and a rectangle light, or under a distant light, takes exactly the direct light of the texels it shadows (the sun's footprint only) and leaves the rest as baked; a box beside every path or behind the lit side changes nothing; a box over the centre takes a sphere's or a spot's direct light, and a box on the path to a corner darkens it under the sphere but not under the spot, whose cone never reaches it; no lights, nothing built

RFC 0011 G4 precomputed radiosity: the furnace enclosure's absolute solve reaches the infinite-bounce value within 2% in the declared convergenceFrames from a cold start and the one-bounce defect never does; switched states match the independent Python solve; the producer publishes the bake exactly at baked scalars, follows a light style, returns to the bake and idles in a still scene
RFC 0011 indirect-light policy: table, availability and the furnace composition
seeded: the total layer read under the RuntimeIndirect variant must fail the furnace
RFC 0011 runtime light set: stable IDs, style scalars, baked-state comparison, epochs and value semantics over a scripted frame sequence
seeded: dynamic IDs from table slots (ID reuse) must be rejected
seeded: style scalars ignored must be rejected
seeded: a non-advancing epoch must be rejected
Scene-derived WMSH PBR (world_pbr.frag) on a real device: packed tangents, material masks, the LMAP atlas, directional and probe paths, with seeded controls

PBRMetalRough on dynamic meshes (model_pbr.frag) against the CPU model built on pbr_brdf.h, with seeded-defect controls; RFC 0011 per-pixel probe-volume sampling against the C++ reference sampler (quality/fixtures/gi/prbv/gpu.prbv)

RFC 0011 G5 compute foundation on a headless device: capabilities queried and enabled through the VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 chain and claimed only as enabled (a provider claiming unenabled ray query is rejected); a compute program writes a storage buffer and an R32F storage image on the graphics queue, read back exactly; a retired resource lives until its submission completes and the seeded early free is caught; validation-clean with the layer. The same source runs on Android from /data/local/tmp

RFC 0011 G6/G7 traced producers on a headless device through the renderer's compute service (render/gpu_compute.h over vulkan_compute's GpuComputeService): the shared producer suite (unittests/rendertest/indirect_contract.h) against the SDF-traced producer and, on a device with ray query, the ray-query producer (the contract scene's triangles as a scene with proxy-box instances), including the geometry oracle (a proxy box around a probe darkens it below 5% of the seed); each traced field's own reference sees no light through the thin wall, and erasing the wall (from the field, or its triangles) is detected; without ray query the ray-query producer fails with missing-feature and creates nothing; sphere and spot lights (SDFV v2) match L r^2 / d^2 cos per texel and the spot's cone leaves a probe outside it unlit (the sphere lights it); a light cell that omits the light leaves its probe unlit; a focus of probe 0 without a budget references probe 0 only, a focus of every probe is the no-focus schedule byte for byte, after a change a focused probe updates while an unfocused one waits, and a budget brings every probe to rest; validation-clean with the layer. The same source runs on Android from /data/local/tmp

RFC 0011 render.indirect-switching on native Vulkan: Baked <-> scripted fake with real frames and completion serials, a failed Begin, a simulated device loss mid-fade; no black frame, fade residency within budget, validation-clean when the layer is present
Synthetic direct-light PBR pixel stage against the headless BRDF model
Transmissive WMSH batches over an opaque scene with readable depth and negative controls
A GPU suite that renders a frame but reports zero checks must fail (RFC 0011 G0): the GPU runner certifies nothing without counted checks

RFC 0011 G4 RTRN reader: the contract transfer validates with its volume and reads back; every malformation of the shared corpus is rejected with the independent Python reader's code; a transfer is rejected against a volume it was not baked for; mutation fuzzing never crashes and accepted mutants read in range

RFC 0011 G6 SDFV reader: the contract volume (version 2, one light cell) validates and its layout is the fixture record's; the every-light-kind volume (rect, distant, dome, sphere, spot with vrad's cone) and its 2 x 2 x 1 light cells read as declared; the previous version-1 contract still validates (no cells); every malformation of the shared corpus (20, including v2 light kinds and cells) is rejected with the independent Python reader's code; mutation fuzzing never crashes and accepted mutants' sections lie inside their bytes
